decision: CLEARED for the exact opt-in owned stage1 preparation implementation only. All four prior required findings are resolved. This does not authorize the old legacy prepare argv, stages2-7, actual capture, candidate comparison or product acceptance. Operational execution still requires publication and a separately reviewed supervisor/readiness update pinned to this source.
scope: Separate31-file exact-commit source/resource copy. Python synthetic tests, owned fake commands, fake Git/archive fixtures, and deterministic clock probes only.

required_findings.evidence: Repeated unchanged original PATH-ps fault mechanism on final source, plus isolated malformed-output and observer-timeout faults. All3 real synthetic brokers terminated their owned command and received no post-reap group signal. Explicit observer faults fail closed by killing the still-self-anchored group; no success is reported.

The original parent extraction function and final default/checked paths match directory timestamp, mode and file bytes in3 synthetic archives with directory modes0755,0000,0500. The checked iterator preserves tar.extractall default filtering and delayed directory attributes.
The unchanged independent clock sequence[0,0,0,1.99,2.01] now returns without ValueError and records mockTERM then mockKILL. No actual signal was sent by the deterministic probe.

Helper publishes readiness only after installing SIGTERM handler; launcher waits for it before PID/status exposure, and test asserts readiness before EOF. Five independent consecutive unchanged focused test invocations exited0; the full suite also passes.

covered_existing_cases: Synthetic real Git archive/source/provenance equivalence versus legacy
Binary archive-style output and captured stdout/stderr preservation
Default child SIGTERM while broker survives as anchor
TERM-resistant group yields unverified failure afterKILL
Work deadline plus fixed cleanup reserve
No post-retirement group signals in the reviewed lifecycle

ownership_conclusion: The exact source has a live broker/session leader that retains PGID identity during same-group membership observation and cleanup. Parent signals only that owned group while anchor is retained, then releases/reaps it and retires its identity. Orphan-observation failures now check their own PGID invariant before bounded TERM/KILL. No process-name kill or Darwin ancestry polling authorizes these signals.
budget_conclusion: Opt-in work budget is bounded1..200seconds with fixed15seconds cleanup reserve. Work checks cover member extraction and source/snapshot digest loops. Kernel/filesystem operations that do not return remain an explicit limit; no absolute uninterruptible-process guarantee is claimed.
legacy_conclusion: Default prepare remains the legacy path. Shared safe_extract metadata regression is repaired. Passing existing95 tests and independent archive comparisons supports the stated scope; it does not prove all arbitrary archive cases or production product parity.
